hero.headline: The best-reviewed nails in Berkeley
hero.sub: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, and custom nail art — walk in or book ahead at our Berkeley studio.

story.title: Welcome to Atelier Nail Co
body: Atelier Nail Co is a full-service nail studio in Berkeley, where a licensed team handles everything from a clean classic manicure to sculpted extensions and custom art.

Every service starts with properly sterilized tools and a fresh file. We take the time to prep the nail correctly, because that is the difference between a set that lasts a weekend and one that lasts for weeks.
We are open seven days a week, and walk-ins are always welcome — though a quick call to (650) 384-6878 guarantees your spot.

trust.label: Open every day of the week

why.title: Genuinely warm service
why.body: You get greeted by name, not processed through a queue. Our regulars stay regulars for a reason.

why.title: Work that actually lasts
why.body: Proper prep and quality product mean gel and dip that hold up for weeks, not days.

why.title: A real spa experience
why.body: Massage chairs, a calm room, and time that never feels rushed — treatment, not transaction.

why.title: Custom nail art on request
why.body: Bring a screenshot or an idea. Our techs design freehand and match what you had in mind.

why.title: Spotless and sanitized
why.body: Fresh files, liners, and fully sterilized tools for every single guest — no exceptions.

why.title: Experienced technicians
why.body: A licensed team that has been shaping, sculpting, and painting nails for years.

reviews.author: Katya Lapina
reviews.text: We had the best experience here! Three of us came to treat ourselves for my mom’s birthday and had the most incredible, friendly, professional service. Loved our mani pedis and just an overall amazing experience.

reviews.author: Rachel Chinta
reviews.text: Wow, this nail spa is simply amazing. If you ever want to feel pampered and beautiful you must visit. They are kind, loving and so professional at making you feel beautiful inside and out.

reviews.author: Kassaundra Tillman
reviews.text: A beautiful relaxing environment with lovely sweet staff. From the moment I entered they were so welcoming, offering water, coffee and a snack. Beautiful nail art. I will be coming back and bringing my friends.

reviews.author: Priya N.
reviews.text: My gel manicure lasted a full three weeks with zero chips. They take real time on the prep and it shows. Spotless salon, sanitized tools, and the shaping is perfect every time.

reviews.author: Danielle R.
reviews.text: Booked a dip powder full set and brought a screenshot of a chrome design. They matched it exactly, freehand. Fair pricing quoted up front and no surprise add-ons at checkout.
